01 — About

More Than Just Numbers.

I am a B.Sc. Information Technology student building my journey in Data Analytics. What interests me most about data is the story behind it — understanding patterns, asking the right questions and finding ways to make information useful.

I have been developing my skills through hands-on practice, personal projects and my ongoing internship at Analytics Career Connect. My learning journey has involved working with Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI and Tableau.

I enjoy turning unorganised information into something structured, understandable and visually meaningful. My goal is to continue growing as an analyst while helping businesses and individuals make better decisions through data.
